change: First issue adds a discrete analytic hull family, computed six-mode response lookup, and beforehand numerical criteria.
Corrects hydrodynamic matrix orientation and homogeneous ship inertia; removes identified irregular-frequency responses from the database and graphs.

Extends the assumed interior-mode screening band to include box_07 at 1.32 rad/s and validates waterline boundary edges before integrating inertia. The re-solve changed retained values by 0.03 % or less below 1.32 rad/s and by up to 1.3 % at 1.32 rad/s (box_00). Two records with identical mesh digests differ by 0.46 % there. The cause is not established.
